# Business-Wrap

> Business-Wrap is a free, open-source (MIT) bilingual requirements document generator. It turns evidence about an e-service (a process model in BPMN, draw.io or YAML, or a crawl of the live service) into an Arabic (right to left) and English (left to right) requirements document, edited in a local HTML editor that is the print layout, and exported to PDF and DOCX with fonts embedded as real text. Local: nothing is uploaded. Claude Code plugin and a local MCP server.

- [Home](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Business-Wrap/): what it does, how it works, features, install, updates, is it safe, FAQ
- [Home in Arabic](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Business-Wrap/ar/): the same page in Arabic, right to left
- [Source](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap): README in English and Arabic
- [Latest release](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap/releases/latest): zip + .sha256
- [Guide](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap/blob/main/docs/guide.md): requirements, quick start, troubleshooting
- [MCP server](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap/blob/main/mcp/README.md): tools and arguments
- [Privacy](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Business-Wrap/privacy.html)
- [Support](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Business-Wrap/support.html)
- [Terms](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Business-Wrap/terms.html)

## Short answers

- Free? Yes. MIT licence, no paid plan, no account.
- Install? Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap`, then `/plugin install business-wrap@business-wrap`. MCP: `claude mcp add business-wrap -- npx -y -p github:NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap#v0.15.5 business-wrap-mcp` for 0.15.5 from the GitHub tag (npm still serves 0.12.0); from a clone: `node <path>/Business-Wrap/mcp/cli.mjs` (no `npm ci` needed).
- Data? Stays on the computer. The one automatic request is the update check, at most once a day, to the public GitHub release list.
- Inputs? A process model (BPMN, draw.io, YAML) or a crawl of a live service; the crawler stops before any final action unless asked twice.
- Outputs? PDF, DOCX, an edits JSON file, a design pack, the editor saved as HTML.
- Languages? Arabic and English, both first-class.
- Updates? In the editor (through `npm run serve`), `npx business-wrap update --check`, or `/plugin marketplace update business-wrap`. Never without consent.
- Requirements? Node 20+, Chrome or Edge, Python with uv for DOCX. Tested on Windows 11.
